The second release of **Synapse Mouse Adjustments**, focused on the Minecraft PvP workflow: Single → Double click no longer has to be always-on, and each mouse button gets its own timing.

## Downloads

| File | Use it for |
|---|---|
| `SynapseMouseAdjustments-1.1.0-Setup-x64.exe` | **Recommended.** Per-user installer: no admin rights, Start-menu shortcut, clean uninstall |
| `SynapseMouseAdjustments-1.1.0-win-x64-portable.exe` | Portable single file for 64-bit Windows. Run it from anywhere |
| `SynapseMouseAdjustments-1.1.0-win-arm64-portable.exe` | Portable single file for Windows on ARM |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums to verify your download |

Requires Windows 10 (1803 or later) or Windows 11. The files are self-contained, so nothing else needs to be installed.

> The files are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**, or check the file against `SHA256SUMS.txt` first.

## New in 1.1.0

- **Toggle hotkey for Single → Double click.** Set any shortcut in *Click Settings* (for example Ctrl+Alt+D) and press it from anywhere — in-game or on the desktop — to pause or resume the feature without opening Synapse. A small on-screen indicator shows **● ON / ○ OFF**. The pause is session-only: your saved config keeps its settings, and restarting Synapse resumes them. Master Enable off and *Reset all settings* also clear the pause.
- **Separate Single → Double click for the left and right mouse buttons.** The *Click Settings* page now has an independent section for the right button with its own:
  - **Double-click interval** (5–500 ms) — the delay between the two clicks.
  - **Click hold time** (1–100 ms) — how long each generated click is held.
  - **Click timing** — *Both on press* (fastest) or *After release*.
- The left and right sections are fully independent: enable only one, or run both with different delays. The PvP presets (Minecraft PvP, Sword PvP, Mace PvP) now pre-fill matching timings for both buttons (50 / 40 / 55 ms) — still off until you enable them.
- Existing 1.0.x configs load unchanged; the right-button settings simply start disabled.

## Honest limitations

- A generic mouse's **hardware DPI, polling rate and switch debounce can't be changed** by any software. Synapse provides software equivalents and labels them as such.
- **Single → Double click** sends ordinary Windows input and does not hide it from anti-cheat. Some servers don't allow double-click tools, so check the rules where you play.
- While an administrator window is focused, Synapse passes input through unchanged, because Windows blocks injected input into elevated apps.

## Safety

- **Ctrl + Alt + Shift + F12** always turns Master Enable off.
- Windows mouse settings are changed for the current session only and restored on exit.
- The toggle hotkey cannot be set to the emergency shortcut or other reserved combinations.

## Verification

This build passed the full unit-test suite (now including right-button timing and pause tests) and an automated runtime check on a Windows runner that launches the app, opens every page, switches configs and toggles Master Enable. It has not been hand-tested with every mouse and game, so please report anything odd.
